WEBVTT

00:00:05 --> 00:00:06
First, taking shade hot take,

00:00:06 --> 00:00:09

00:00:09 --> 00:00:10
and adding orgasm crave

00:00:10 --> 00:00:12
almost as a blush topper for a rounded and youthful look.

00:00:13 --> 00:00:16
using these same shades to create a more editorial and sculpted look

00:00:16 --> 00:00:17

00:00:17 --> 00:00:20

00:00:20 --> 00:00:22
The multiple is easy to blend and super long wearing

00:00:22 --> 00:00:24

00:00:24 --> 00:00:25
It comes in 12 versatile shades

00:00:25 --> 00:00:27
to elevate all of your summer makeup looks.

00:00:27 --> 00:00:30
Such a beautiful formula that I'll be wearing all summer long.
